evidence.observation: The binding completion clause states: "Milestone closure replays two source documents, a duplicate observation, one accepted group, one declined group and an interrupted restart." This is listed among the five amendments that "supersede shorthand in the phase table" (line 71).

The recorded replay covers "a valid unattended model, supplies bytes for a second document", "an already-observed tuple from its distinct cited occurrence", "one digest-bound proposal with a row move and a deletion", and an interruption "at finalization after the model CAS" with a completing invocation. No declined group appears in this replay; the only declined-group evidence is a separate control: "Changing the supporting source of a declined group offers it again." The uninterrupted-vs-resumed comparison is therefore never shown to include a declined group's decision identity, work counters or terminal reason.

concerns.recommendation: Either extend the closure replay to include declining one group before the interruption so the resumed/uninterrupted comparison covers it, or record an explicit disposition explaining why a separate control satisfies amendment 5's mandatory replay composition.
concerns.title: Declined group absent from the amendment-5 closure replay

evidence.observation: The record states: "The post-repair focused and RF6 checks returned 32 passed in 17.73s before the directory-alias regression was added... The phase structure, CLI, packaging, install, doctor, disclosure and CG1–3 selection on the earlier implementation returned 1053 passed, 2 deselected in 170.41s... The wheel test preceded the final review repairs." The broad 1053-test verification and the packaged-wheel run both predate the final review repairs, so the post-repair state rests on the 32-test focused run alone.

concerns.recommendation: Re-run the phase-structure selection (or full suite) on the final post-repair bytes and record the verbatim summary, so the shipped state is covered by more than the focused consolidation/RF6 tests.
concerns.title: Broad-suite result predates final CG3 repairs

evidence.observation: The clause requires: "Put the replay and exact results in the milestone close record."

The close record describes the comparisons qualitatively ("It compares the complete model bytes, all durable decision fields (including IDs and work counters), and the resulting report and terminal reason") but records no actual counter values, terminal reason string, or final model digest. The exact values exist only inside the referenced test file, not in the close record itself.

concerns.recommendation: Append the recorded terminal reason, decision IDs, work counters and final digest (or a pointer-plus-summary block) to the close record so the close artifact alone carries the exact results amendment 5 demands.
concerns.title: Close record describes but does not record exact replay results

summary: The CG3 record and close-delta honestly document a two-document replay with duplicate observation, accepted group, interrupted restart and equivalence comparison, plus scoped residuals (no corpus trials, reporter models unavailable). One mandatory element of plan amendment 5 is not demonstrated as specified: the declined group is exercised only as a separate control, not inside the closure replay whose uninterrupted-vs-resumed comparison is the completion criterion. Two lower-grade gaps concern verification freshness and recorded exact results.
